13031-indian-games-and-dances-with-nativ.title: Ceremonials and Sports
13031-indian-games-and-dances-with-nativ.creator: Alice C. Fletcher
13031-indian-games-and-dances-with-nativ.description: A book by Alice C. Fletcher. men and women had previously sung but which for me had been buried under a tumultuous din. Thenceforth my ears were opened and never again, no matter how confusing the conditions, did I fail to catch the hidden melody. As my appreciation of the value of Indian music grew, I determined to gather and to preserve these wild flowers of song.

arxiv-2106-05324.title: On Rainbow Cycles and Proper Edge Colorings of Generalized Polygons
arxiv-2106-05324.creator: Matt Noble
arxiv-2106-05324.description: Abstract An edge coloring of a simple graph G G is said to be proper rainbow-cycle-forbidding (PRCF, for short) if no two incident edges receive the same color and for any cycle in G G , at least two edges of that cycle receive the same color.

arxiv-2112-05833.title: Helicity shedding by flux rope ejection
arxiv-2112-05833.creator: B. Kliem, N. Seehafer
arxiv-2112-05833.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by B. Kliem, N. Seehafer. We quantitatively address the conjecture that magnetic helicity must be shed from the Sun by eruptions launching coronal mass ejections in order to limit its accumulation in each hemisphere. By varying the ratio of guide and strapping field and the flux rope twist in a parametric simulation study of flux rope ejection from approximately marginally stable force-free equilibria, different ratios of self- and mutual helicity are set and the onset of the torus or helical kink instability is obtained.

arxiv-2212-06530.title: Maker-Breaker domination game on trees when Staller wins
arxiv-2212-06530.creator: Csilla Bujtás, Pakanun Dokyeesun, Sandi Klavžar
arxiv-2212-06530.description: Abstract In the Maker-Breaker domination game played on a graph G G , Dominator’s goal is to select a dominating set and Staller’s goal is to claim a closed neighborhood of some vertex. arxiv-2301-04920.title: On the Validity of Consensus (Extended Version) Conference: PODC 2023; TBD; Orlando, USA; TBD CCS: Computing methodologies Distributed algorithms
arxiv-2301-04920.creator: Pierre Civit, Seth Gilbert, Rachid Guerraoui, Jovan Komatovic, Manuel Vidigueira
arxiv-2301-04920.description: Abstract . The Byzantine consensus problem involves n n processes, out of which t < n t<n could be faulty and behave arbitrarily. Three properties characterize consensus: (1) termination, requiring correct (non-faulty) processes to eventually reach a decision, (2) agreement, preventing them from deciding different values, and (3) validity, precluding “unreasonable” decisions. But, what is a reasonable decision?

arxiv-2305-20063.title: On the Origin of Linearity and Unitarity in Quantum Theory
arxiv-2305-20063.creator: Matt Wilson, Nick Ormrod
arxiv-2305-20063.description: Abstract We reconstruct the transformations of quantum theory using a physically motivated postulate. This postulate states that transformations should be locally applicable , and recovers the linear unitary maps from pure quantum theory, as well as the completely positive, trace-preserving maps from mixed quantum theory.

arxiv-2307-00687.title: Estranged facets and k k -facets of Gaussian random point sets
arxiv-2307-00687.creator: Brett Leroux, Luis Rademacher
arxiv-2307-00687.description: Abstract Gaussian random polytopes have received a lot of attention especially in the case where the dimension is fixed and the number of points goes to infinity. Our focus is on the less studied case where the dimension goes to infinity and the number of points is proportional to the dimension d d .

arxiv-2311-17996.title: Filament formation due to diffusive instabilities in dusty protoplanetary disks NumPy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , CMasher ( van der Velden 2020 )
arxiv-2311-17996.creator: Konstantin Gerbig, Min-Kai Lin (林明楷), Marius Lehmann
arxiv-2311-17996.description: Abstract We report the finding of a new, local diffusion instability in a protoplanetary disk, which can operate in a dust fluid, subject to mass diffusion, shear viscosity, and dust-gas drag, provided diffusivity, viscosity, or both decrease sufficiently rapidly with increasing dust surface mass density.

arxiv-2402-07521.title: A step towards the integration of machine learning and small area estimation
arxiv-2402-07521.creator: Tomasz Żądło
arxiv-2402-07521.description: Abstract The use of machine-learning techniques has grown in numerous research areas. Currently, it is also widely used in statistics, including the official statistics for data collection (e.g. satellite imagery, web scraping and text mining, data cleaning, integration and imputation) but also for data analysis.

arxiv-2410-11004.title: Communication Fast Plasma Frequency Sweep in Drude-like EM Scatterers via the Reduced-Basis Method
arxiv-2410-11004.creator: Clara Iglesias-Tesouro, Valentín de la Rubia, Alessio Monti, Filiberto Bilotti
arxiv-2410-11004.description: Abstract In this work, we propose to use the Reduced-Basis Method (RBM) as a model order reduction approach to solve Maxwell’s equations in electromagnetic (EM) scatterers based on plasma to build a metasurface, taking into account a parameter, namely, the plasma frequency. We build up the reduced-order model in an adaptive fashion following a greedy algorithm.

arxiv-2410-18498.title: XTE J1814-338: A potential hybrid star candidate
arxiv-2410-18498.creator: P. Laskos-Patkos, Ch.C. Moustakidis
arxiv-2410-18498.description: Abstract A recent analysis on the properties of the XTE J1814-338 pulsar yielded a small radius value around ∼ \sim 7 km. Notably, this estimation is significantly lower compared to the currently inferred values for the radius of neutron stars (as they are derived from both theoretical calculations and corresponding observations).

arxiv-2508-12285.title: “ My productivity is boosted, but … ” Demystifying Users’ Perception on AI Coding Assistants
arxiv-2508-12285.creator: Yunbo Lyu 2 , Zhou Yang 3 1 , Jieke Shi 2 , Jianming Chang 4 , Yue Liu 2 , David Lo 2
arxiv-2508-12285.description: Abstract This paper aims to explore fundamental questions in the era when AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot are widely adopted: what do developers truly value and criticize in AI coding assistants, and what does this reveal about their needs and expectations in real-world software development?

plos-pone-0009837.title: C/EBPα and C/EBPβ Are Required for Sebocyte Differentiation and Stratified Squamous Differentiation in Adult Mouse Skin
plos-pone-0009837.creator: John S. House, Songyun Zhu, Rakesh Ranjan et al.
plos-pone-0009837.description: PLOS ONE research article. C/EBPα and C/EBPβ are bZIP transcription factors that are highly expressed in the interfollicular epidermis and sebaceous glands of skin and yet germ line deletion of either family member alone has only mild or no effect on keratinocyte biology and their role in sebocyte biology

pmc-10628166.title: Three-dimensional label-free morphology of CD8 + T cells as a sepsis biomarker
pmc-10628166.creator: MinDong Sung, Jong Hyun Kim, Hyun-Seok Min, Sooyoung Jang, JaeSeong Hong, Bo Kyu Choi, JuHye Shin, Kyung Soo Chung, Yu Rang Park
pmc-10628166.description: Sepsis is a dysregulated immune response to infection that leads to organ dysfunction and is associated with a high incidence and mortality rate. The lack of reliable biomarkers for diagnosing and prognosis of sepsis is a major challenge in its management. We aimed to investigate the potential of three-dimensional label-free CD8 + T cell morphology as a biomarker for sepsis.

pmc-11465096.title: Antiosteoporosis Medication Prescriptions After Fragility Fractures
pmc-11465096.creator: William K. Silverstein, Sping Wang, Mahnaz Alavinejad, Ania Sarnocinska, Nathan M. Stall, Kamil Malikov, Michael P. Hillmer, Jonathan S. Zipursky
pmc-11465096.description: This cohort study assesses prescribing rates for antiosteoporosis medication following a fragility fracture and factors associated with filling a prescription after a fracture among patients in Ontario, Canada. Introduction Pharmacologic treatment for secondary osteoporotic fracture prevention is recommended after an initial fragility fracture of the hip, vertebrae, or pelvis, regardless of bone mineral density, to reduce subsequent fracture risk.

pmc-11690375.title: THE ROLE OF HETEROGENEITY IN NEUROCOGNITIVE AGING
pmc-11690375.creator: Sylvain Moreno
pmc-11690375.description: Neurocognitive aging research has predominantly adopted a linear approach, categorizing aging populations homogeneously. Researchers like Salthouse argue that this perspective perceives cognitive decline as almost linear from early adulthood. However, emerging findings challenge this view, highlighting significant variability in cognitive aging and proposing different subtyping methods to study the neurocognitive aging population.

pmc-12430822.title: Influence of Bioactive Glass Incorporation in Resin Adhesives of Orthodontic Brackets on Adhesion Properties and Calcium Release
pmc-12430822.creator: Ana Paula Valente Pinho Mafetano, Fernanda Alves Feitosa, Gabriela da Silva Chagas, Nathália Moreira Gomes, Marcella Batista Rocha, Mariane Cintra Mailart, Karen Cristina Kazue Yui, Cesar Rogério Pucci, Gonzalo R Quezada, Ricardo Jeldres
pmc-12430822.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study evaluated a light-cure orthodontic adhesive with the incorporation of bioactive glass particles and its effects on shear bond strength (SBS), adhesive remnant index (ARI), degree of conversion (DC), calcium release, and particle size distribution.

pmc-12506132.title: Study protocol for an open-label, single-arm, mixed methods feasibility study of the MWIQ AI-powered decision support tool for diabetes management in GP practices
pmc-12506132.creator: Jane Dickson, Scott G Cunningham, Chris Sainsbury, Martin K Rutter, N Kanumilli, Ewan Pearson, Doogie Brodie, Marryat Stevens, Deborah J Wake, Nicholas Conway
pmc-12506132.description: IntroductionDiabetes affects ~10% of the world’s population and is rising. Treatment costs in the UK are ~15% of the NHS budget. Diabetes-related complications can be lowered through better evidence-based clinician management and patient self-management. MyWay intelligence quotient (MWIQ) is an electronic platform that will provide clinical decision support around the diagnosis and treatment of patients with diabetes.

pmc-12613526.title: The multifaceted roles of fatty acids and their dysregulation in obese mothers: potential implications for infant development
pmc-12613526.creator: Boqun Liu, Yuqing Liu, Chuang Zhai, Xuan Wu, Yanmei Wang, Xibi Fang
pmc-12613526.description: The increasing global rates of obesity underscore the need to investigate its impact on infant health. Breast milk, crucial for infant nutrition, varies in composition due to maternal obesity during pregnancy. Research reveals that obese or overweight mothers tend to have higher saturated fatty acids (SFAs) levels, like palmitic and myristic acids, while stearic acid levels are lower.

pmc-13348098.title: Caregiving burden and perceived stress in family caregivers of cardiac patients
pmc-13348098.creator: Seyede Fatemeh Gheiasi, Mahmoud Rouhbakhsh, Soheila Rabie Siahkali
pmc-13348098.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCardiac diseases often require prolonged caregiving, imposing substantial burden and stress on family caregivers.ObjectiveThis study aimed to assess caregiving burden and perceived stress among family caregivers of cardiac patients and to examine their associations with demographic and care-related factors.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 259 caregivers of cardiac patients (aged ≥ 18 years, ≥ 6 months of caregiving) at the emergency department of Ayatollah Mousavi Hospital, Zanjan, Iran, in 2024.

pmc-13399463.title: Associations Between Noise Exposure, Psychological Status, and Fertility Intentions Among Female Healthcare Professionals of Childbearing Age in Shenzhen
pmc-13399463.creator: WenWen Wan, ChangYu Deng, SiQi Chen, He Wang, YueYun Wang
pmc-13399463.description: Objective:To explore the factors that influence the fertility intention of female medical staff of childbearing age in Shenzhen and analyse the association of noise exposure with their psychological status and their correlation with fertility intention.Methods:A questionnaire survey was conducted among 615 female medical staff members. Data on basic demographics, fertility intentions, and the general well-being scale were collected.

pmc-13416799.title: Assessment of MR‐Induced Heating Effects in Four Common Veterinary Implants at 1.5 and 3.0 T: A Phantom Study
pmc-13416799.creator: Manabu Kurihara, Taichi Kimura, Kenji Yodo, Shuhei Shibukawa
pmc-13416799.description: Quantitative evaluation of implant‐related heating in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is well standardized in human medicine, whereas evidence in veterinary medicine remains scarce. To address this gap, we measured radiofrequency (RF)‐induced heating of four used veterinary implants under controlled conditions on clinical 3.0 and 1.

pmc-13609836.title: Exploratory Grouping Along a Shared Oral-Health Burden Continuum in Children and Adolescents: An Age-Stratified Cluster Analysis
pmc-13609836.creator: Narcis Mihaita Bugala, Smaranda-Adelina Bugala, Mihaela Jana Țuculină, Ancuta Ramona Camen, Alina Nicoleta Capitanescu, Dragos Cadea, Adrian Macovei, Loredana Selaru, Ana Maria Rica, Dana Maria Albulescu
pmc-13609836.description: Background and Objectives: Caries experience, plaque accumulation, gingival inflammation, and periodontal screening findings may coexist as manifestations of a shared oral-health burden. We examined whether these routinely recorded indicators form distinct multivariable profiles or primarily represent ordered levels along a common burden continuum in children and adolescents.
